title: Warding (Columbae)
heading: Major Supernatural Virtue: Warding
summary: The Columbae's Accelerated Ability for drawing chalk circles that ward away a subset of one Form. The Warding Total acts as a Casting Total for natural targets and as Penetration against beings with Might, but is useless against Magic Resistance without Might.
quotes: Warding Total: stress die + Stamina + Warding + aura
a ward against objects made of wood requires a Warding Total of at least 30
related: ArM5 p.114 Ring Duration / Circle Target

title: Wards and Penetration
heading: Wards and Penetration
summary: Explains that Hermetic warding spells must penetrate Magic Resistance, why high-level wards are impractical, and why Arcane Connections generally cannot boost Penetration for ward spells.
quotes: these wards must penetrate Magic Resistance to have their effect

title: Ward Guidelines
heading: Ward Guidelines
summary: Spell guidelines for wards in each Form, all at Touch range, Ring duration and Circle target. Used to set levels for Hermetic ward spells and for the Warding Ability.
quotes: All of them are presented at Range Touch, Duration Ring, and Target: Circle
Ward against human beings. (Touch, Ring, Circle)

title: Banishing (Donatores)
heading: New Virtue: Banishing
summary: A Supernatural Accelerated Ability that expels creatures of one realm from a designated area for a Sun duration, with an Ease Factor depending on area size and a re-entry roll for the banished creature that reduces its Might. Includes a worked example.
quotes: Banishing Total: stress die + Presence + Banishing + aura
the default Ease Factor is Near Range, which is defined as the area within 10 paces of the character
Stamina + (Realm) Lore roll against an Ease Factor of 12
related: ArM5 p.148 Weight of a Thousand Hells
RoP: The Infernal p.34 True Names

title: Laying Ghosts and Revenants the Mundane Way
heading: Doing it the Hard Way
summary: Non-magical methods of putting restless ghosts and vengeful revenants to rest, such as completing unfinished tasks, giving a proper burial, or exhuming, beheading and blessing the grave of a revenant.

title: The Path of Orpheus
heading: The Path of Orpheus
summary: Describes a rumored great ritual that follows Orpheus into the Underworld to restore a dead loved one to life, modelled on the rituals of Fenicil. Gives its parameters, requirements and the limits and risks of its success.
quotes: with an Ease Factor of 78, Range *Adelphixis*, Duration Momentary, and Target Individual
related: Houses of Hermes: True Lineages p.76 (Fenicil)

title: Mythic Herbalism Ease Factor Table
heading: Mythic Herbalism Ease Factor Table
summary: Table of Ease Factors for the healing effects, poisons and physical-bonus potions that a Mythic Herbalism user can brew.

title: Profession Apothecary
heading: Profession Apothecary
summary: Ability for identifying and preparing medicinal ingredients. Lack of proper medicinal supplies penalizes Medicine rolls and the patient's Recovery bonus, and a skilled apothecary reduces that penalty.
quotes: makes all Medicine rolls at a penalty of –3

title: Mythic Herbalism
heading: Major Supernatural Virtue: Mythic Herbalism
summary: A Supernatural Ability for brewing healing poultices, poisons and potions of physical bonuses: preparation time scales with the Ease Factor, extra doses raise the Ease Factor, and an Intelligence + Mythic Herbalism roll decides success. Describes expiry, duration and stacking limits.
quotes: a number of days equal to one-third the Ease Factor of the intended effect
the Ease Factor is increased by one for each additional dose
roll the character's Intelligence + Mythic Herbalism against the target Ease Factor

title: Induction of Hedge Wizards into the Order
heading: Induction of Hedge Wizards into the Order
requires: House Ex Miscellanea: Lineage of Pralix (inducting maga)
summary: Procedure for bringing a Gifted hedge wizard into the Order: a short apprenticeship in Hermetic basics, an attempt to open the Arts that may destroy non-Hermetic powers, a season teaching the Parma Magica, then the Oath. Explains the Flaws and Gifted Companion status that can result.
quotes: typically lasting less than five years
The Pralician maga need not have all Arts above 5 for this process

title: Joint Training of Apprentices
heading: Joint Training of Apprentices
requires: House Ex Miscellanea: Lineage of Pralix
summary: Describes the arrangement in which a Pralician teaches Hermetic magic to a hedge wizard's apprentice in exchange for laboratory assistance, producing an apprentice trained in both traditions.
quotes: for every season the Pralican spends teaching Hermetic magic to her colleague's apprentice, she gets two seasons of the apprentice's assistance in the laboratory

title: Opening the Arts of a Hedge Wizard
heading: Opening the Arts of a Hedge Wizard
summary: Summary of the rules for opening the Arts of a character with Supernatural Abilities: compare an Intellego Vim Lab Total to a level based on the Supernatural Ability scores, and the margin decides whether the Abilities are lost or converted into Hermetic Virtues.
quotes: Level Required for Opening the Arts: 5 x (the sum of all Supernatural Ability scores)
Minimum Level per Ability: 10 if the Ability derives from a Minor Virtue, or 30 if it derives from a Major Virtue

title: Comprehend Magic (Ability)
heading: New Supernatural Ability: Comprehend Magic\*
summary: Supernatural Ability for analysing the magic in an object, person, aura or vis. A Comprehension Total is compared to an Ease Factor by source of magic, with more rounds of study revealing more, and the insight boosts the user's spells and lab work against the studied target.
quotes: Comprehension Total: Perception + Comprehend Magic + stress die
The observer may add twice his Comprehend Magic score to the Casting Total of any spontaneous Muto, Perdo, or Rego Vim spell used against the object or creature studied

title: Pralicians and Scrying
heading: Pralicians and Scrying
summary: Explains how using Comprehend Magic on another magus counts as scrying under the Code of Hermes, and when a Tribunal is likely to convict.
quotes: Using Comprehend Magic against another magus is scrying, and forbidden by the Code of Hermes

title: New Spell Guideline: Rego Vim
heading: New Spell Guideline
summary: A Rego Vim guideline for sustaining or suppressing spells of a specific type cast by another, limited by the level of the Vim spell.
quotes: Sustain or suppress a spell or spells of a specific type cast by another with level less than or equal to the level + 2 magnitudes of the Vim spell

title: Mastery Ability: Unraveling
heading: New Mastery Special Ability: Unraveling
summary: A mastery special ability for Perdo Vim spells that destroy magic, adding a multiple of the Mastery score to the spell's effective level when determining whether it can destroy the targeted spell.
quotes: The magus may add three times his Mastery score to the effective level of the Perdo Vim spell when determining whether it can destroy the targeted spell

title: Mastery Ability: Rebuttal
heading: New Mastery Special Ability: Rebuttal
summary: A mastery special ability for Muto or Rego Vim spells that affect another being's spell or power, adding a multiple of the Mastery score to the spell's effective level when changing or controlling foreign magic.
quotes: The magus may add three times his Mastery score to the effective level of the Vim spell when determining whether or not it can change or control the foreign magic

title: Craft Magic (Rusticani)
heading: Major Supernatural Virtue: Craft Magic
summary: Lets a character craft an object in place of casting an effect, with shape and material bonuses capped by his Craft score, and also to make charged items and lesser enchantments of vis-containing objects without spending a season. Four applications, each with its own time and level rules and worked examples.
quotes: though this bonus cannot exceed his Craft score
Use the character's Casting Total or the result of the Supernatural Ability roll as if it were a Lab Total to determine the effect's level and the number of charges
the level of the invested effect cannot exceed five times the number of pawns of vis in the object
related: RoP: The Divine pp.137-138 Craft Amulets

title: Design and Inscription Bonuses
heading: Design and Inscription Bonuses
summary: Enchantment bonuses from portraits, writing, seals or symbols and images that Craft Magic users can add to crafted effects and some lab work, in addition to shape and material bonuses.
quotes: Note that the total bonus gained from shape, material, design, and inscription is still limited to the magus's Magic Theory score (or an applicable Craft score)

title: The Jinn
heading: The Jinn
summary: Describes jinn as spirits of place with a spiritual and a material form, the three kinds of jinn by realm, their typical Might, and their regeneration and Virtues.
quotes: typically Mights range from 5–40
related: Realms of Power: The Divine ch.5 Mythic Islam

title: Sihr (Summoning and Bargaining with Jinn)
heading: Major Supernatural Virtue: Sihr
summary: A Supernatural Accelerated Ability for summoning a jinni and bargaining it into service. Covers discerning a jinni's Might, the vis cost and Summoning Total, extra summoning time, the Bargain Total against an Ease Factor, botches, and how many jinn may be kept in service.
quotes: Summoning Total: Presence + Sihr + Aura + stress die
Bargain Total: Communication + Bargain + Summoning Strength + stress die
Ease Factor: 18 + Bargain Modifiers
related: Realms of Power: The Divine ch.5 Mythic Islam

title: Bargain Modifiers (Sahirs)
heading: Bargain Modifiers
summary: Table of modifiers to the Ease Factor of a sahir's bargain with a jinni, depending on the scope of the terms, length of service, any duty accepted and vis spent above or below the standard cost.

title: Typical Duties for Sahirs
heading: Typical Duties for Sahirs
summary: Examples of simple and onerous duties a sahir may accept to modify a bargain with a jinni.

title: Siren Song (Seirenes)
heading: Siren Song
summary: A Major Virtue letting the character command those who hear her music, resolved as a Communication + Music roll against the target's Stamina roll with a bonus table by command severity. Limits help from other musicians and explains how it combines with Enchanting Music.
quotes: A successful roll of Communication + Music versus the target's Stamina roll allows the character to issue a command to any individual or group who hears the music
No more than two musicians' scores can assist the singer in performing a song

title: Agencies Overview
heading: Appendix: Agencies
summary: Introduces agencies, networks of mundane contacts through which a principal pursues goals without being implicated in meddling, and defines principals and agents.
quotes: A character controlling an agency is called its **principal**, in this chapter.
An **agent** is a person bound to offer assistance to a principal.

title: Agents are Directly Controlled
heading: Agents are Directly Controlled
summary: Gives the formula for the maximum number of agents a principal can directly control, based on Presence, Intrigue or Leadership and the Gift's social penalty, and what happens if it is exceeded.
quotes: Maximum Number of Agents: [2 x (Presence + Intrigue
A character can always control one agent, no matter how poor his social skills or what the penalty of his Gift.

title: Agents Act as Intermediaries (Factors)
heading: Agents Act as Intermediaries
summary: Explains that most people commanded through an agency are resources controlled by an agent rather than extra agents, and introduces the factor, a single agent who runs the whole agency using his own statistics.
quotes: An agent employed to control an entire agency on behalf of a magus is called a **factor**.

title: Designing Agents
heading: Designing Agents
summary: Lists the few statistics needed for each agent (name, Social Status, Bond, resources) and the Difficult Underlings problem when a principal controls an agent of higher social standing, with magi exempt.
quotes: A Bond , which is a Personality Trait that expresses the reason that the agent is subordinate to the principal

title: Partial Adoption (Agencies)
heading: Partial Adoption
summary: Optional approach in which troupes do not convert Virtues and Flaws such as Social Contacts or Close Family Ties into fully described agencies, tracking only agents gained during play.

title: Recruiting Agents at Character Creation
heading: Recruiting Agents at Character Creation
summary: Lists the Virtues and Flaws that grant an agency at the start of play and explains how to buy agents with agency points from the Resistance of Agents Table.
quotes: The player has 12 agency points to spend.

title: Recruited Agents as Story Rewards
heading: Recruited Agents as Story Rewards
summary: How to recruit an agent during play: impress the prospect with a roll, earn agency experience points from stories to wear down his Resistance Strength to zero, and build a Bond. Also covers inheriting an agency and why agents cannot be bought.
quotes: Impressing a Potential Agent: Presence + Leadership – social penalty of The Gift + stress die vs. Ease Factor 6
It takes the current value of a given Resistance Strength in agency experience points to decrease that strength by one

title: Using Agents
heading: Using Agents
summary: How a principal sets agents tasks: a Persuasion Roll against an Ease Factor from the Tasks for Agents table, then a roll or side story for the task itself. Covers using agents for information or assistance and limits on how often they can be asked.
quotes: Persuasion Roll: Communication + Charm, Intrigue, or Leadership + Bond Strength – social penalty of The Gift + stress die vs. Ease Factor (see table under Tasks for Agents)
related: Modifiers to Persuasion Roll Ease Factors

title: Resistance of Agents (rules)
heading: Resistance of Agents
summary: Explains Resistance Strength, an agent's reluctance to serve, how it is reduced to zero and how the Bond Strength then grows, with a cap, and notes that Hermetic magi are never agents.
quotes: to a maximum of +6, representing a fanatically dedicated agent

title: Confounding Situations
heading: Confounding Situations
summary: Guidance on how often an agent's Flaws make him unavailable to the principal, and how the Difficult Underlings Story Flaw applies to a whole agency.
quotes: an agent with a Minor Flaw might be unable to help his principal once out of every four requests

title: Maintaining Agents
heading: Maintaining Agents
summary: Agencies need upkeep: stories can lower an agent's Bond Strength, and it is raised through favors, which convert Adventure experience into agency experience, or money, which can only raise it up to a limit.
quotes: One Mythic Pound's worth of material goods can take the place of 5 agency experience points (or 4 shillings per point) without need for a story
Bond Strength can never rise above +3 by the application of money

title: Resistance of Agents Table
heading: Resistance of Agents Table
summary: Tables of base Resistance by Social Status and the modifiers for Flaws, coercion and useful resources, used to cost agents at creation and to set the difficulty of recruiting them. A minimum applies.
quotes: A potential agent's Resistance cannot be less than 1.

title: Tasks for Agents
heading: Tasks for Agents
summary: Table of Ease Factors for the Persuasion Roll to get an agent to supply information or perform an easy, hard or impressive task.

title: Modifiers to Persuasion Roll Ease Factors
heading: Modifiers to Persuasion Roll Ease Factors
summary: Modifiers to a Persuasion Roll Ease Factor for how soon the task must be done and the personal risk to the agent, including the number of botch dice.
